query: France Ebola case 2026: current status of the doctor who tested positive after aid mission, any secondary cases, ECDC reporting. How many confirmed Ebola cases in France as of July 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here are the key findings:

**Confirmed Ebola cases in France as of July 2026: 1 (one)**

- **The case:** A humanitarian doctor (ALIMA NGO) tested positive for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain on June 24, 2026, after flying from DRC to Charles de Gaulle on June 23. This was France's first-ever Ebola case detected on its territory and the first to test positive outside Africa in the 2026 outbreak.

- **Current status of the doctor:** **Recovered and discharged from hospital on July 4, 2026** (announced by Health Minister Stéphanie Rist), after two negative PCR tests. The patient was nearly asymptomatic (only headaches).

- **Secondary cases:** **None.** Contact tracing identified five flight passengers as possible contacts, placed in precautionary isolation with 21-day monitoring. No onward transmission occurred.

- **ECDC reporting:** ECDC assessed the risk to the general European population as **"very low"** and issued 2026 Bundibugyo contact-tracing/risk-classification guidance. (Note: separate US-citizen cases were medically evacuated to Germany in May and July 2026 — these are not French cases.)

The case was widely cited as a successful containment. All findings have been recorded in the structured output.
